tool.name: Cell Ranger Multi
tool.description: 3' GEX with on-chip multiplexing (OCM) via 10x Genomics Cell Ranger
tool.command:
mkdir -p fastqs_gex &&
## Symlink GEX R1/R2 pairs with CellRanger-expected naming convention #if $input_mode.mode == 'manual': #set $lane = 1 #for $r1, $r2 in zip($input_mode.fastq_r1, $input_mode.fastq_r2): ln -sf '${r1}' fastqs_gex/${run_id}_GEX_S1_L00${lane}_R1_001.fastq.gz && ln -sf '${r2}' fastqs_gex/${run_id}_GEX_S1_L00${lane}_R2_001.fastq.gz && #set $lane = $lane + 1 #end for #else: #set $lane = 1 #for $pair in $input_mode.fastq_collection: ln -sf '${pair.forward}' fastqs_gex/${run_id}_GEX_S1_L00${lane}_R1_001.fastq.gz && ln -sf '${pair.reverse}' fastqs_gex/${run_id}_GEX_S1_L00${lane}_R2_001.fastq.gz && #set $lane = $lane + 1 #end for #end if
## Build multi config CSV printf '[gene-expression]
' > multi_config.csv && printf 'reference,%s
' '${transcriptome.fields.path}' >> multi_config.csv && #if str($no_bam) == 'true': printf 'create-bam,false
' >> multi_config.csv && #else: printf 'create-bam,true
' >> multi_config.csv && #end if printf 'include-introns,%s
' '${include_introns}' >> multi_config.csv && #if $expect_cells: printf 'expect-cells,%s
' '${expect_cells}' >> multi_config.csv && #end if #if $chemistry != 'auto': printf 'chemistry,%s
' '${chemistry}' >> multi_config.csv && #end if printf '
' >> multi_config.csv && printf '[libraries]
' >> multi_config.csv && printf 'fastq_id,fastqs,lanes,feature_types
' >> multi_config.csv && printf '%s_GEX,%s,,Gene Expression
' '${run_id}' "\$(pwd)/fastqs_gex" >> multi_config.csv && printf '
' >> multi_config.csv && printf '[samples]
' >> multi_config.csv && printf 'sample_id,ocm_barcode_ids
' >> multi_config.csv && #for $s in $samples: printf '%s,%s
' '${s.sample_id}' '${s.ocm_barcode_id}' >> multi_config.csv && #end for
cellranger multi --id='${run_id}' --csv=multi_config.csv --localcores=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-8} --localmem=\$(( \${GALAXY_MEMORY_MB:-65536} / 1024 )) &&
## Copy individual outputs cp '${run_id}/outs/qc_report.html' '$qc_report' && cp '${run_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5' '$filtered_matrix' && cp '${run_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz' '$filtered_barcodes' && cp '${run_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz' '$filtered_features' && cp '${run_id}/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz' '$filtered_matrix_mtx' && cp '${run_id}/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5' '$raw_matrix' && cp '${run_id}/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz' '$raw_barcodes' && cp '${run_id}/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz' '$raw_features' && cp '${run_id}/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz' '$raw_matrix_mtx' && cp '${run_id}/outs/qc_library_metrics.csv' '$qc_library_metrics' && cp '${run_id}/outs/qc_sample_metrics.csv' '$qc_sample_metrics' && cp '${run_id}/outs/raw_molecule_info.h5' '$molecule_info' && tar -czf '$full_outs' -C '${run_id}' outs

param.name: mode
param.label: FASTQ input mode
param.help: Choose between manual R1/R2 selection or auto-detect from a paired collection.

param.name: fastq_collection
param.label: Paired-end FASTQ collection
param.help: Collection of paired R1/R2 FASTQ files for the Gene Expression library.

param.name: fastq_r1
param.label: FASTQ R1 files
param.help: Read 1 files (cell barcode + UMI). Must be paired with R2 files in the same order.

param.name: fastq_r2
param.label: FASTQ R2 files
param.help: Read 2 files (cDNA). Must match R1 files in number and order.

param.name: run_id
param.label: Run ID
param.help: Unique alphanumeric identifier used as the output directory name.

param.name: transcriptome
param.label: Reference transcriptome
param.help: Cell Ranger-compatible reference. Ask your administrator to add entries to cellranger_transcriptomes.loc.

validator.message: No Cell Ranger references are configured on this server.

repeat.name: samples
repeat.title: Sample
repeat.help: Assign each OCM barcode to a sample. Each of the four on-chip barcodes (OB1–OB4) may only be used once.

param.name: sample_id
param.label: Sample ID
param.help: Unique name for this sample in the output (e.g. treated_A).

param.name: ocm_barcode_id
param.label: OCM barcode
param.help: On-chip barcode assigned to this sample. OB1=blue, OB2=red, OB3=yellow, OB4=green.

param.name: expect_cells
param.label: Expected number of cells (per sample)
param.help: Override Cell Ranger's automatic cell detection. Leave blank to use auto-detection.

param.name: no_bam
param.label: Skip BAM output
param.help: Skip BAM file creation to save storage and processing time.

param.name: include_introns
param.label: Include intronic reads
param.help: Count reads mapping to pre-mRNA (introns). Recommended for single-nucleus RNA-seq.

tool.help:
**Cell Ranger Multi — 3' GEX with On-Chip Multiplexing (OCM)**
Runs ``cellranger multi`` to demultiplex up to 4 samples pooled using the 10x Genomics on-chip multiplexing (OCM) technology. OCM barcodes are physically embedded in the chip, so no separate capture library is needed — only the standard Gene Expression FASTQ files are required.
**On-chip barcodes**
Each sample is assigned one of four on-chip barcodes:
- OB1 — blue well - OB2 — red well - OB3 — yellow well - OB4 — green well
**Inputs**
- **FASTQ files**: Paired-end Gene Expression reads. Provide as a paired collection or by selecting R1/R2 files manually. Multiple lanes are supported. - **Reference transcriptome**: Pre-built Cell Ranger reference directory on the server. - **Samples**: Assign each loaded sample a unique ID and its OCM barcode (OB1–OB4). A minimum of 2 and maximum of 4 samples are supported.
**Outputs**
Individual output files:
- **QC Report**: Interactive HTML report with per-library and per-sample QC metrics. - **Filtered Feature-Barcode Matrix (h5 / MTX)**: Count matrix containing only cell-containing barcodes, in both HDF5 and Market Exchange formats. - **Raw Feature-Barcode Matrix (h5 / MTX)**: Count matrix for all detected barcodes. - **QC Library / Sample Metrics**: CSV tables of key sequencing and cell statistics. - **Raw Molecule Info**: HDF5 file used for downstream aggregation with ``cellranger aggr``.
The **Full outs (tar.gz)** archive contains everything above plus::
per_sample_outs/<sample_id>/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 per_sample_outs/<sample_id>/outs/metrics_summary.csv per_sample_outs/<sample_id>/outs/web_summary.html multiplexing_analysis/cells_per_tag.json raw_cloupe.cloupe config.csv
**Reference**
`10x Genomics Cell Ranger Multi — 3' with OCM <https://www.10xgenomics.com/support/software/cell-ranger/latest/analysis/running-pipelines/cr-3p-multi#ocm>`_
